notes:
• Account details. A bank account can now keep its account name, account number, branch, routing number and SWIFT code. A bKash, Nagad, Rocket or Upay wallet keeps its wallet number and type (personal, agent or merchant). A Rapid Pass keeps its card number and whether it is registered. Numbers show only their last 4 digits until you tap Show, and you can copy each one or share them all when someone sends you money. Cards still keep only their last 4 digits.

• Daily limit, day by day. On Budget, tap Day by day under your daily limit to see every day of the budget month: what you spent, what you saved or how far you went over, today, and the days ahead. The monthly report (PDF and Excel) now has the same day-by-day table, and a report for a month that has ended counts its daily savings too.

• Home now shows Spending by month after your savings goals.

• Fixed: deleting a loan left its payout and processing fee in the account the money went to, so that account (often bKash) showed too much. Deleting a loan now removes all its entries. A loan you deleted before this update may still have its payout in your entries: open the account, delete that payout and its fee, then use Balance looks wrong? to check the balance.

• Fixed: a loan could lose EMIs from its repayment plan when a payment was made with Prepay or deleted and entered again, down to no EMIs while money was still owed. The plan now always comes from the loan's own schedule, and on opening this version any loan whose plan covers less than you owe gets its EMIs back. No balance changes. Deleting the payment that cleared a loan opens the loan again, and undo closes it again.

• Fixed: closing an FDR, DPS or Sanchayapatra early now moves its money to an account. A plan closed earlier with money still in it shows an Encash button.

• Fixed: the monthly report PDF froze the app for a month with many entries (about 50 or more). Long tables now continue on the next page.

• Fixed: money spent with a debit card now counts on its bank account in the monthly report, the tax-year summary and savings account interest, and debit cards no longer show as separate accounts in the report.

• Fixed: net worth on past days (the trend, the reports' starting figures) now counts money that was in an FDR or other plan you have since encashed.

• Fixed: a savings account's interest schedule kept stopping after the account was edited; it now rolls on. Loan interest in reports stays right after a loan is renamed.

Already on an older version? Open Settings, then App updates, to install this one. Your data stays. A backup made on 0.3.6 cannot be restored on an older version.
